sampling_method: A = key rename/collision (CoheEtal08a, MarsEtal06, YantMord91, Hirs86, Whal20, Kopp78), ENTRYTYPE change (NeweRose81), identity_quote_failed (Bull90), ambiguous/no_source (vand95, ElliEtal95), plus title/journal changes to a different journal or a substantively different title (GonzEtal05, ElliEtal85, MacLKamp96, SnodVand80, CorbWick78, GlenEtal83, MurdOkad70, PollEtal68, Shap70, SchuEtal01, Metc90, StepBaer06, vandHint08, OjemDodr85, RatcEtal94, ShifEtal93, MurdKaha93b, Hell62, Nils74, Aber40, Mitc09, Pier63); JEP:General -> JEP renames and typo-only journal fixes were left in the pool. pool = sorted keys not in A (168); B = random.Random(20260928).sample(pool, round(len(pool)/3)) = 56. Each sampled entry re-fetched from Crossref REST (81 records), PubMed E-utilities (<=1 req/s), JMLR pages, LoC SRU; final merged.json values judged.
systematic_findings: POST-CHECK BUG (new): the name normaliser turns an unbraced particle in the CITED name into an initial ('B A L Di Leone' -> 'B A L D Leone'), and surname_single_source then holds the researcher's brace fix {Di Leone} and keeps the corrupted form as 'the cited name' (VogtEtal14, in B). A brace/particle fix of the same letters should not be a surname respelling, and a hold must keep the HEAD string verbatim.

POST-CHECK BUG (new): the contained-type journal-to-series move overrides the researcher's explicit remove list; NeweRose81 (@article -> @incollection because the JMP article does not exist) ends with Series {Journal of Mathematical Psychology}.

POST-CHECK BUG (new, outside sample): house journal formatter maps 'Journal of Physiology-Paris' to 'Journal of Physiology' (helpers.format_journal_name, reproduced), so LachEtal03 silently keeps the wrong journal although the researcher corrected it and the DOI record says Journal of Physiology-Paris; no flag is raised and final_changes hides it.

POST-CHECK (doi_title_mismatch false drops): correct DOIs dropped for a Crossref title with a 'Book Review:' prefix and price (Mitc09, in A), a numeral for a spelled number (Waug63b: '2 methods' vs 'Two methods') and a glued italic genus (WehnSrin81: 'genusCataglyphis'); normalise digits/number words and split glued words before comparing.
POST-CHECK (network): two DOIs held only because Crossref returned HTTP 429 (CeraHend65, HaymTulv89); rerun with slower pacing rather than send to the user.

Noise / working as designed: surname holds on values two sources corroborate (TaylEtal04 Batty, LowEtal20 Ghosh, AshbEtal93 Balakrishnan, KeppEtal68 Zavortink: released here by agree verdicts); Aber40 Abernethy and CranPari57 Parrish have only the Crossref deposit and stay for the user. Researcher quality otherwise high: 30 of 32 set-A entries (incl. all 6 key changes and 9 journal reassignments) are right.
Researcher/house (minor): MillEtal07d copied the journal's 'denNijs' instead of HEAD's M {den Nijs}.
outside_review_set_findings: LachEtal03: journal should be 'Journal of Physiology-Paris' (Crossref 10.1016/j.jphysparis.2004.01.018 container); post-check formatter reverted it to 'Journal of Physiology'.
Waug63b, WehnSrin81: researcher DOIs 10.1037/h0041501 and 10.1007/bf00605445 are the cited works; dropped by the title check.
CeraHend65, HaymTulv89: DOIs held on HTTP 429 only.
